title: Configuration and State in CLI Tools knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which approach best supports reliable work with Configuration and State in CLI Tools?
options: Validate configuration at startup and fail clearly when required settings are missing or malformed.
Skip input validation because Node.js applications run on a trusted server.

questions.answer_key: Validate configuration at startup and fail clearly when required settings are missing or malformed.
